# OpenRouter Provider





<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) OpenRouter API key. Can also be set via OPENROUTER_API_KEY environment variable.

### Optional

- `app_title` (String) App display name for OpenRouter dashboard. Can also be set via OPENROUTER_APP_TITLE environment variable.
- `referer` (String) Site URL for OpenRouter rankings. Can also be set via OPENROUTER_REFERER environment variable.
